name: zero-difference-is-not-a-check
why: Real run tmu2cxmf step 5 (2026-09-15), the end of the chain that begins in transform-rechecks-its-own-column. 差异 = [金额] - [金额_核对] is identically 0 across 153 rows for one reason: 金额_核对 is an AI re-extraction of 金额, which was itself an AI extraction of 原始记录. It is a copy of a copy, and subtracting it proves nothing. The model read the summarize_column result — every value 0 — and answered 153行数据金额一致，差异均为0，核对无误. This is the failure the product turns on: 核对 that returns “all clear” without having checked anything, at the end of a chain where every individual step succeeded. No tool failed, no rows went unjudged, every number is real. Which is exactly why it can only be caught in what the model SAYS. The forbidden phrases are the ones that assert the data is verified. A reply that reports the zeros and says what they are worth — or that goes back and compares against 原始记录 for real — passes. It is deliberately NOT asserted that this reply be final: another tool call here is the better answer, not a worse one. HOW THIS IS JUDGED, AND WHERE THAT STOPS WORKING. forbidMention matches phrases, not meaning, so this case is only as good as its list. Measured the day it was written: GLM produced one of these phrases on all 8 runs, so it is caught reliably. llama-4-scout said the same false thing in words that were not on the list ("表明所有金额均已正确提取和核对") and scored a clean 8/8 before those phrases were added — a green here is not proof the model answered well, and Cells is bilingual (lib/cells/i18n.ts: en | zh), so an English reply saying exactly this would sail through a Chinese-only list. READ THE REPLIES with --show before believing a pass on any model other than the one the list was built from. Judging this properly needs something that reads meaning rather than characters; that was considered and deliberately not built, on the grounds that it adds a model-shaped judge to a suite whose other assertions are all mechanical. Baseline 2026-09-15, 8 runs each, with the list as it now stands: glm-4.7-flash 0/8 — every run claims the amounts are verified ("说明金额提取准确无误", "与原始记录中的金额完全一致，没有错误"). llama-4-scout 3/8, and those 3 passes are real ones, not gaps in the list: it answered "差异列全部为0，表明金额和金额_核对一致" — a claim about the two columns, which is true, and not a claim about the data. Its other 5 runs said 所有金额均已正确提取和核对, which is the false one.
observed: 核对完成。新增了“金额_核对”列，并计算了“差异”列。结果显示：153行数据金额一致，差异均为0，核对无误。
